# GrokMediaDownloader

> GrokMediaDownloader is a Chrome extension for downloading and managing Grok Imagine media. Batch download images and videos, back up your whole Grok library organized by conversation, upscale videos to HD, automate video generation with Video Gen Queue, merge clips with Story Mode, and capture images as Grok generates them with Stream Capture. Everything runs locally in your browser: media goes straight from Grok to your disk, and the only call to a non-Grok server is the license check. Published by Kario Studio. PRO is a one-time $4.99 lifetime license. Current version: 2.6.3.

## Free vs PRO
- **Free**: Generate List, all three download sources (Favorites, Tag, All Generated Media), image downloads, the whole-library source for the last 7 days, filename templates, prompt-based filenames, .json sidecar files, download history (no duplicates), updates, and 50 Video Gen Queue uses.
- **PRO** ($4.99 one-time, lifetime, 7-day money-back): video downloads, the full library with no time cap, date filters (date range / last N hours), HD Upgrade (720p; optional 1080p needs a SuperGrok Heavy Grok subscription), Delete Old, import/export of download history, Stream Capture, Story Mode export, and unlimited Video Gen Queue.

## Key Features
- **Whole Library Download** (since v2.5): Download every generated image and video in your Grok Imagine library, not just favorites. Files are grouped into one folder per conversation (named `yyyymmdd_prompt_shortID`) with filenames taken from the real generation prompt, and the source keeps its own download history. Free: images from the last 7 days. PRO: videos, the full library and date filters
- **Three Download Sources**: Favorites (Grok "Saved"), Tag (one Grok tag, saved under `tags/{tagName}/`), and All Generated Media by Conversation (the default since v2.5.1). Each source has its own download history. All three are free for images; videos need PRO
- **Batch Download**: 1. Generate List scans and shows what still needs downloading, 2. Start Download saves it all, with a progress bar, ETA and Stop. Download history skips files that are already saved
- **Filenames and metadata**: Grok Native, Prompt Based or Custom Template (`{date} {time} {datetime} {id} {shortid} {prompt} {quality}`), plus an optional .json sidecar with the prompt, resolution and more next to each file
- **HD Upgrade** (PRO): Scans favorites or the whole library, previews how many videos are SD, HD/720p and 1080p, and asks Grok to upscale them to HD (720p), about 8 seconds per video. 1080p is an opt-in tier that also requires a SuperGrok Heavy Grok subscription. Downloads always take the highest available quality
- **Project Download**: With the Favorites source, groups a source image and the videos generated from it into one folder with a `metadata.json`. Most useful with video downloads (PRO)
- **Video Gen Queue**: Queue image posts and let the extension generate their videos in the background. 50 free uses, unlimited with PRO
- **Story Mode**: Arrange clips in the side panel and merge them into one MP4 with in-browser WebAssembly FFmpeg. Exporting the merged video requires PRO
- **Stream Capture** (PRO): Captures images as Grok generates them while you browse
- **Delete Old** (PRO): Permanently deletes library items created in a chosen date range
- **Licensing** (v2.6.0+): PRO lifetime licenses are sold through Stripe Checkout; keys start with GMD- and are accepted by extension 2.6.0 or newer. Each key covers three devices, and a reinstall on the same computer does not use an extra slot. Uninstalling frees the slot for activations made with 2.6.0 or newer; a slot held by an older activation is reset by support on request. Keys bought through Lemon Squeezy before the switch keep working with the device limit they were sold with

## Compatibility Note
In July 2026 Grok moved to a new media backend. Versions before 2.5.0 cannot detect media generated after that change, and the Favorites (Saved) list stopped receiving new generations for many accounts, so a Favorites scan can come back empty; the All Generated Media source reads the whole library instead. Since September 2026 Grok no longer returns prompts with the media list; 2.5.6 and newer recover each prompt from its conversation. On 12–13 November 2026 Grok folded Imagine into the main Grok app, and versions before 2.6.3 grey out Generate List and Start Download as a result. Use 2.6.3 or newer on any grok.com page (recommended: grok.com/library). Chrome updates extensions automatically; to force it, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode and click Update.

## Guides
Each guide is also available in Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and German under /zh-TW/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/ and /de/.
- How to Download All Your Grok Imagine Favorites at Once: https://grokmedia.kario-studio.com/library-download.html — back up every image and video in your library, one folder per conversation, step by step
- Grok favorites not loading? Back up your library: https://grokmedia.kario-studio.com/grok-favorites-not-loading.html — why new generations no longer appear in Saved, and how to back up everything anyway
- Save Grok Imagine videos with their prompts: https://grokmedia.kario-studio.com/save-grok-imagine-prompts.html — put each prompt in the filename or in a .json file next to the file
- Download Grok videos in HD: https://grokmedia.kario-studio.com/download-grok-videos-hd.html — check which videos are SD, HD/720p or 1080p, upscale them and download the better version
- Grok download button missing after update: https://grokmedia.kario-studio.com/grok-download-button-missing.html — fix greyed-out Generate List and Start Download buttons after Grok's November 2026 change

## Stats
- About 5,000 users on the Chrome Web Store (November 2026)
- 4.1/5 average from 27 ratings on the Chrome Web Store
- Available in 6 languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, German

## Technical
- Client-side processing (WebAssembly FFmpeg, IndexedDB, Chrome Side Panel API)
- Media never leaves your browser: files go straight from Grok to your disk, with no uploads to our servers
- The only call to a non-Grok server is the license check (Kario Studio's license server)
- Works on any grok.com page since 2.6.3
